services.name: Boat Charters
services.desc: Key West, known as the “Sport Fishing Capital of the World,” offers anglers a prime location for offshore fishing charters. With its proximity to the Gulf Stream, the waters surrounding Key West are teeming with a diverse range of fish species. Fun in The Sun Key West, a renowned charter company, provides the ultimate fishing experience in this angler’s paradise. Whether you’re targeting sailfish, marlin, tuna, or mahi-mahi, their experienced captains and crew ensure an unforgettable adventure. From novice anglers to seasoned pros, Key West’s crystal-clear waters, warm climate, and abundant marine life make it a top choice for those seeking world-class offshore fishing charters. services.name: Snorkeling Charters
services.desc: See the Florida Keys’ underwater world on a private snorkeling charter. Your local captain takes your group to vibrant patch reefs and clear, shallow flats teeming with marine life - and snorkel gear is included on every captained trip, along with bottled water and ice. It’s a private boat, so you go at your pace, with no crowds. Combine snorkeling with a sandbar stop, dolphin watching, or fishing - most guests do. Great for families and first-time snorkelers; the captain picks the calmest, clearest spots for the day’s conditions. up to 12 people per boat (use multiple boats for more than 12). services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: End your day the way Key West is meant to be seen - from the water. Our private 1.5-hour sunset & scenic cruises start at $425 and are yours alone: bring your crew, your drinks, and your camera while a local captain finds the perfect spot for the sky to light up. Want something extra special? Book the 43′ Lisa Lynn luxury yacht for a sunset cruise with friends and family. Bottled water and ice are provided; bring your own food and drinks. up to 12 people per captained boat (more aboard the Lisa Lynn / via bareboat charter). Book direct and save. blurb: Guests can enjoy private boat charters with local captains, boat rentals with or without drivers, and golf cart rentals. The company offers a variety of tours including sandbar charters, fishing, snorkeling, sunset cruises, and trips to Dry Tortugas & Fort Jefferson. They focus on safety, customer satisfaction, and personalized experiences.
